notes: V0.9.3: Google Drive backup + backend hardening. The same encrypted backup blob (AES-GCM, password-derived key) can now also be stored in the user's own Google Drive, in the app's private appDataFolder (drive.appdata scope only — the app can never see the user's other Drive files). Google only ever sees ciphertext. OAuth 2.0 with PKCE (no client secret in the app); the refresh token is sealed with the backup key before storage, and re-sealed on password change. Settings -> Cloud backup gains Connect / Back up / Restore / Disconnect Google Drive, plus a paste-code fallback. Needs a Google Cloud OAuth client ID (DRIVE_CLIENT_ID) — until Kodi provides it, Drive backup stays off and the server backup keeps working. Server (worker-v093.js): security headers on every response (HSTS, nosniff, frame deny, no-referrer, no-store) and a per-user /send rate limit (60/min). Deploy with bash cloudflare.sh.
